description: Source code for managing build points, efficiency prediction, and team budgets in the game Unvanquished, including functions for calculating build point budgets, efficiency deltas, and buildable values.

methods.name: RGSPredictEfficiencyLoss
methods.description: Predicts the efficiency loss of an existing miner if a new miner is constructed nearby.

methods.name: G_RGSPredictEfficiencyDelta
methods.description: Predicts the total efficiency gain for a team when a miner is constructed at a given point.

methods.name: G_UpdateBPVampire
methods.description: Updates the build point vampire status for a client or all players.

methods.name: G_UpdateBuildPointBudgets
methods.description: Calculates and updates the build point budgets for both teams.

methods.name: G_RecoverBuildPoints
methods.description: Recovers build points over time based on game match time and recovery rates.

methods.name: G_GetFreeBudget
methods.description: Returns the number of free (unspent and unqueued) build points for a team.

methods.name: G_GetMarkedBudget
methods.description: Returns the total build points of buildables marked for deconstruction for a team.

methods.name: G_GetSpendableBudget
methods.description: Returns total spendable build points including free and marked buildables.

methods.name: G_FreeBudget
methods.description: Decreases the spent budget and increases queued budget for a team.

methods.name: G_SpendBudget
methods.description: Increases the spent budget for a team.

methods.name: G_BuildableDeconValue
methods.description: Calculates the build point value of a buildable entity, considering health and vampire effects.

methods.name: G_GetTotalBuildableValues
methods.description: Calculates total buildable values in build points for both teams.
